notes.title: Marriage and divorce
notes.intro: Jesus teaches that marriage is a lifelong union, with an exception “for sexual immorality” in Matthew’s account. Churches apply this differently.

views.label: A valid sacramental marriage cannot be dissolved
views.summary: Catholic teaching holds that a consummated sacramental marriage lasts until death; a declaration of nullity (annulment) may find that a valid marriage never existed.

views.label: Divorce is tragic, but remarriage may be allowed in mercy
views.summary: Orthodox churches may permit a second (and rarely third) marriage after divorce, with a penitential service, as an act of pastoral mercy (oikonomia).
views.source: Orthodox Church in America, “Marriage, Divorce and Remarriage” (guidelines)

views.label: Divorce and remarriage are permitted in some circumstances
views.summary: Many Protestant churches allow divorce for adultery or desertion, and remarriage, while upholding marriage as lifelong.
